title: Senior CRM Executive
description:
Senior CRM Executive

Liverpool On-Site Salary: DOE Full-time Permanent

We're working with a growing business in Liverpool looking to add a Senior CRM Executive to its marketing team.

This is a hands-on opportunity for someone who enjoys getting into the detail of CRM, understanding customer behaviour and using data to improve engagement and retention.

You'll have the opportunity to take ownership of campaigns across multiple channels, develop automated customer journeys and work closely with teams across the wider business.

The Role

You'll be responsible for:

Managing the end-to-end delivery of CRM campaigns across multiple channels

Building, scheduling and optimising email campaigns

Developing and improving automated customer journeys

Creating targeted customer segments using behavioural and transactional data

Supporting CRM activity around key trading periods and campaigns

Working closely with Marketing, Ecommerce and Creative teams

Supporting customer retention and loyalty initiatives

Analysing campaign performance and identifying opportunities for improvement

Testing different audiences, messaging and customer journeys

Helping develop the wider CRM and retention strategy

What We're Looking For

We're looking for someone with 2+ years' experience within CRM, retention, email marketing or a similar role.

You'll ideally have experience across areas such as:

CRM campaign management

Email marketing

Marketing automation

Customer segmentation

Automated journeys

Personalisation

Campaign analysis and reporting

A/B testing and optimisation

Experience using Klaviyo or another CRM/ESP platform would be beneficial.

You'll need to be organised, commercially minded and comfortable managing multiple campaigns while working with different teams across the business.

What's On Offer

Competitive salary, depending on experience

Permanent, full-time position

Liverpool-based opportunity

Generous holiday allowance

Company bonus scheme

Employee discount

Additional company benefits

If you're currently working within CRM and looking for an opportunity where you can take more ownership and continue developing your experience, I'd be keen to speak with you.

title: PPC Executive
company: Adele Carr Recruitment Limited - Agency - Permanent
description:
PPC Executive

Location: Liverpool
Salary: £35,000-£40,000 per year, depending on experience
Working arrangement: Hybrid

An established and highly regarded law firm is looking for an experienced PPC Executive to join its growing marketing team.

This is an opportunity to take ownership of paid search campaigns across a range of legal practice areas, using your analytical skills and legal marketing knowledge to generate high-quality enquiries and support business growth.

Previous PPC experience within the legal sector is essential. You must have a proven track record of managing paid search campaigns for legal services, either within a law firm or a legal marketing environment.

The role

You will manage the day-to-day delivery, optimisation and performance of paid search campaigns, ensuring budgets are used effectively and campaigns deliver a strong return on investment.

Working closely with the wider marketing team, you will identify opportunities to improve campaign performance, increase conversion rates and attract relevant enquiries across multiple legal service lines.

Key responsibilities
- Manage and optimise Google Ads campaigns across a range of legal practice areas.
- Monitor campaign performance, advertising spend, conversions and return on investment.
- Conduct keyword research and competitor analysis within the legal market.
- Review campaign data to identify trends, performance issues and opportunities for improvement.
- Implement campaign changes to improve lead quality, conversion rates and budget efficiency.
- Produce regular performance reports with clear insights and practical recommendations.
- Use Google Analytics and conversion tracking to understand campaign effectiveness and inform decisions.
- Work collaboratively with the wider marketing team to align paid search activity with business growth objectives.
- Keep up to date with PPC trends, advertising platform updates and developments in legal sector marketing.

About you

You will be commercially minded, analytical and confident using data to make decisions. You will understand the specialist nature of legal lead generation and be able to demonstrate how your work has contributed to campaign results.

Essential experience and skills
- Previous experience in a PPC Executive, Paid Media or similar role.
- Demonstrable experience managing PPC campaigns within a law firm or legal marketing environment.
- A proven track record of generating enquiries for legal services.
- Strong working knowledge of Google Ads, Google Analytics and conversion tracking.
- Experience monitoring and managing campaign budgets.
- Strong keyword research and competitor analysis skills.
- Excellent analytical and reporting abilities.
- A commercial approach to improving campaign performance and return on investment.
- Strong attention to detail and the ability to manage competing priorities.
- Clear communication skills and a collaborative approach to working with colleagues.

What's on offer
- Salary of £35,000-£40,000, depending on experience.
- Hybrid working.
- Career development opportunities.
- A supportive and collaborative marketing team.
- The opportunity to contribute to the growth of a respected legal business.
- Company pension.
- Company events.
- Employee discount.
- Free on-site parking.
- Referral programme.
- Sick pay.

How to apply

If you have experience delivering successful PPC campaigns within the legal sector and are looking for your next opportunity, please apply with your latest CV.

Please note: legal sector PPC experience is essential. Applications without relevant legal marketing experience are unlikely to be considered.

title: Trainee Digital Marketing Manager No experience needed (Ref: 6901)
description:
DIGITAL MARKETING TRAINEESHIP (REMOTE)

Become a Digital Marketing Professional and Build Real-World Experience

Are you interested in digital marketing, online business, and helping organisations grow through effective marketing strategies? Do you want to gain practical experience while developing skills that employers are actively looking for?

We are offering a Digital Marketing Traineeship designed to help aspiring digital marketers develop industry-relevant knowledge through structured learning and practical projects.

What You Will Learn

Throughout the traineeship, you will develop an understanding of:
- Digital Marketing Fundamentals
- Marketing Strategy and Planning
- Search Engine Optimisation (SEO)
- Pay-Per-Click (PPC) Advertising
- Social Media Marketing
- Content Marketing
- Email Marketing
- Google Analytics and Marketing Analytics
- Conversion Rate Optimisation (CRO)
- Customer Journey Mapping
- Branding and Positioning
- Market Research and Competitor Analysis
- Artificial Intelligence (AI) for Marketing
- Marketing Automation
- Campaign Planning and Performance Measurement
- Marketing Reporting and Data Analysis

Practical Experience

You will work on realistic marketing projects that may include:
- Developing digital marketing strategies
- SEO audits and optimisation recommendations
- Social media campaign planning
- Content creation and marketing calendars
- Email marketing campaigns
- Marketing analytics and reporting
- Website optimisation projects
- Competitor research
- Brand positioning exercises
- Portfolio projects demonstrating your marketing skills

This practical experience will help you develop a professional portfolio that demonstrates your capabilities to future employers.

Ideal Candidate

We are looking for individuals who:
- Have an interest in marketing, business, and technology
- Enjoy analysing data and solving problems
- Have good communication skills
- Are creative and eager to learn
- Can work independently and manage their time effectively
- Have basic computer skills

No previous digital marketing experience is required. Successful applicants will undertake our paid Digital Marketing training programme before progressing into employment. The cost of the training is the responsibility of the learner, and full guidance and support will be provided throughout the programme.

Benefits
- Remote and flexible learning
- Industry-relevant curriculum
- Portfolio development opportunities
- Practical project experience
- Mentoring and personalised feedback
- Career guidance and employability support
- Opportunity to develop skills sought by modern employers

Entry Requirements
- A good level of written English
- Access to a computer and internet connection
- Motivation to learn and develop professionally

Career Opportunities

Upon successful completion, learners may pursue roles such as:
- Digital Marketing Executive
- Digital Marketing Specialist
- SEO Executive
- PPC Executive
- Content Marketing Executive
- Social Media Executive
- Email Marketing Executive
- Marketing Coordinator
- Marketing Analyst
- Growth Marketing Executive
- Performance Marketing Executive
- Digital Marketing Assistant

Apply Today

If you are looking to start a career in Digital Marketing and want to gain practical experience while developing a professional portfolio, we would love to hear from you.

Submit your application today and begin your journey towards a career in one of the world's fastest-growing industries.

We advertise this role across multiple UK locations - you only need to apply once and you'll be considered for all of them.
